author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Creates Twitch clips from !clip and optionally publishes other clips made during the observed current stream to a Discord channel or forum.
changelog: 3.5.0: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 3.5.0, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 3.0.0: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 3.0.0, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.6.1: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 2.6.1, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.6.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.6.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.2: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.2 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.1: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.1 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.0: added a Twitch-only !clip creation path, 30/60-second duration control, direct created-clip relay, and strict current-stream timestamp filtering for optional discovery. Older library clips no longer qualify. 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge baseline. 2.4.2: initial stable-ID Discord delivery release.

manifest.name: Clip Courier

actionsProvided.name: THSV Addon - Clip Courier - Create Clip

installationSteps: Import the matching Clip Courier Streamer.bot package. Review its disabled Twitch-only !clip command, then enable it.
Open Create Clip and set clipCourierDurationSeconds to 30 or 60. Leave its imported !clip trigger attached.
Open Deliver, replace clipCourierWebhookUrl with a private webhook created for the selected Discord text channel or forum, then Save and Compile. Leave Deliver triggerless.
Approve only Deliver in the wizard. The command-created clip returns directly to Clip Courier; automatic background discovery uses the shared Clip Library Cache.
Optional: enable other clips from the current stream. Older clips and clips from prior streams are rejected by creation time.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its bounded publication history remains preserved.

healthChecks.description: Confirms command clip creation, current-stream filtering, and idempotent Discord publication are available.
